messages:
Claire (Product): quick sync — planning Q3 initiative 'predictive-cache rollout' that reduces tail latency for hosted + dedicated. need to align on scope, sequencing, and security gating. @Jules @Tess @Liam @Amit please chime with rough estimates. link: https://docs.redwood.local/predictive-cache-draft :point_right:

Jules (Runtime): skimming doc — looks reasonable. main runtime work: KV-prefetch heuristics + eviction policy hooks. rough estimate: 3w for prototype + 2w to stabilize for 1 model family. question: do we need multi-model support at launch or can we do model-by-model?

Amit (Eng): SDK/API changes? will the new cache be opaque or surfaced to users? if surfaced, we need contract + migration plan. if opaque, less work on API. also: telemetry events for cache hits/miss will be needed.

Claire (Product): prefer opaque initially (auto-enable per-customer toggle), to avoid API churn. acceptance criteria I care about: 1) 20–30% reduction P95 for targeted workloads, 2) graceful fallback when cache miss or corruption, 3) rollout kill-switch and metrics. will add to doc.

Tess (Infra): for Dedicated we need capacity headroom/slot changes. if predictive prefetch increases GPU memory footprint by ~10–15%, we'll need to reserve extra nodes. can you add expected memory and QPS delta per-model? otherwise assume +20% buffer and 2wk lead for capacity requests.

Liam (Security): quick list: does predictive cache persist any customer input? where are keys stored? we need a data-flow diagram and KMS integration plan for cache encryption. also request threat model for cache poisoning attacks.

Amit (Eng): will add telemetry and data-flow notes. plan: expose a runtime flag and a hidden Console toggle for initial customers. SDK unchanged.

Jules (Runtime): multi-model support can be phased. plan: start with a single GA model variant (bert-embedding-like family), then add others. prototype will include a config manifest, e.g.:

```
cache:
  enabled: true
  max_prefetch_tokens: 2048
  eviction: lru_ttl: 300
  encryption: kms: "aws-kms://alias/redwood-cache"
```

Tess (Infra): that manifest helps. add expected per-instance mem + disk numbers. infra will draft capacity request template by EOD Friday.

Claire (Product): proposed sequencing: 1) finalize spec + security checklist (end of next week), 2) runtime prototype (3w), 3) infra capacity request & staging rollout (2w parallel), 4) initial canary with 5 pilot customers, 5) GA. Can teams confirm those timeboxes? :thumbsup:

Jules (Runtime): can do prototype in 3w if spec is stable by Monday.

Tess (Infra): we can meet 2w for provisioning after we get numeric estimates. provisioning lead: @tess.

Liam (Security): will schedule a quick review session; need DF diagram + KMS plan before review.

Amit (Eng): SDK unaffected, will add telemetry hooks. target: canary in 6w if all goes well.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary window for predictive-cache rollout: tentative 2026-05-10 -> 2026-05-24 (pending infra approval).

Claire (Product): awesome — I'll update the doc with these commitments and ping legal for CCPA notes. follow-ups: add the memory/QPS numbers, security DF, and canary runbook. thanks all.
